entries.en: Nice work with those geth. Glad you showed up.
Would it help if I brought in some power cells from the Normandy? We can certainly spare a few.
I found these power cells in the tunnels. Are they what you're looking for?
If I find anything while I'm looking around, I'll send it your way.
Take a look at these.
Normandy's power cells
And with the power cells you brought, I can get this place up and running again. Thanks, Commander.
Thanks for getting me these power cells. Now, hopefully, I can get this damn thing working.
I bet these things ignored the geth. Can't eat metal.
The varren probably did not recognize the geth as food. We, on the other hand, appear most appetizing.
Xenogenic field manuals warn against triggering a food response in local predators. It appears we don't have a choice.
The geth ignored these beasts. Their only targets were the colony survivors.
That should keep Fai Dan and the others safe. After an update we can head out for the main geth encampment.
So, are we ready to roll out to wherever the geth are bunkered? Check in with Fai Dan, but I think we are done here.
Now we can update Fai Dan and get a vehicle safely out of the Normandy. The geth base is our next objective.
We should update Fai Dan on the situation before we move on to wherever the geth are bunkered. He's the closest thing left to proper channels.
The geth will be back. Update Fai Dan, but don't take long. We should roll out the vehicle and find where the geth are bunkered.
And now to the geth base. Ready for anything, Commander.
All right, heading for the geth base. Let's take it to them.
And now to the geth base. Not something an intelligent being would typically say.
And now to the geth base. Not something an intelligent mind expects to say.
And now to the geth base. Expect heavy resistance.
Good view of where we need to go.
Nice view of where we need to go.
A good vantage point showing out destination.
An optimal view of where we need to go.
A good view of where we need to go.
Careful. Smells like a slaughterhouse. Organic preds, not geth.
Ugh, what's that smell? Geth don't stink like that.
Holy... it reeks down here.
These tunnels have an odor much more... visceral than geth.
I smell... carrion. And lots of it.
The local predators probably ignored the geth. Can't eat metal.
Fai Dan would probably like to know there are other survivors.
I suppose we should tell Fai Dan about the others.
Should we alert Fai Dan to the other survivors? He is the acting leader here.
Fai Dan should be told of the other survivors. He is acting leader, after all.
Fai Dan will be interested in the other survivors. As leader, I would be.
What is that? There's no way that's human, infection or not.
You got it, Commander. Let's do this.
Whatever you say, Commander. Let's do it.
As you order, Commander Shepard.
Very well, Commander. Let's go.
As you would have it, Commander Shepard.
Hold on. What about those nerve grenades? Can't we use them to disable the colonists?
I hear that, but what about those nerve grenades we jury-rigged with Baynham?
Are we abandoning the nerve grenades we received from Dr. Baynham?
We did acquire nerve grenades from Dr. Baynham. Do you want us to use them?
What about the nerve grenades we acquired? We could potentially incapacitate the colonists.
Very well, Commander. If that's what you want.
All right. It's too bad there's no other way. They can't help themselves.
It is regrettable, but if you say there is no other option, that is just the way it is.
Very well. It is regrettable, but it is your decision.
It's a shame there is no other way. Their actions are not their own.
What the hell was that? I don't know what that plant does to people, but that's not human.
No amount of infection could have altered a human to that extent. I wonder what is going on here?
What was that creature? It certainly wasn't human.
That thing was not one of the colonists. No amount of infection could have done that.
No hitting the colonists, even if the Thorian makes them fire on us. That's what the gas grenades are for.
Fire if you have to, but let's try to keep casualties to a minimum. They can't help themselves.
I want a clean sweep. Nothing hostile lives to take a second shot.
All right. Try not to tag the colonists, but we have to get through no matter what.
We don't have time to waste on these people. There's a galaxy at stake.
Careful. Leave the colonists.
Try to avoid the colonists.
Wipe everything out.
Fine, but don't take chances.
We can't take the chance.
They are definitely protecting the Borealis. We've got to move one of those cargo blocks.
They are all over the Borealis. Let's move one of the cargo blocks and see what crawls out.
It is clear that they are protecting the Borealis. We have got to move one of those cargo blocks.
They are definitely protecting the ship, Commander. We've got to move one of those cargo blocks.
They definitely want to keep us from the ship. We've got to move one of those cargo blocks.
There's the crane. Can you make sense of the controls, Commander?
There's the controls for the crane, Commander. Can you make sense of them?
There are the controls for the crane, Commander Shepard. Can you make sense of them?
There's the crane, Commander. Can you make sense of the controls?
There's the target, Shepard. Can you make sense of the controls?
They're definitely bunkered around the Borealis. We've gotta move one of its cargo blocks once we're topside.
Yeah, they're bunkered around the Borealis up there. We've got to move one of its cargo blocks once we're topside.
The colonists are clustered around the Borealis. It may be difficult to move one of its cargo blocks.
They are definitely bunkered around the Borealis. We've got to move one of its cargo blocks once we're topside.
They are bunkered around the Borealis. We'll have to move one of its cargo blocks once we're topside.
Commander. I was told to make my supplies available to you, if you wish.
Of course. I may be able to provide a few interesting items.
A well-stocked freighter can be a profitable investment on a new colony.
But once I was here, I decided to stay on. The colony life grows on you after a while.
Yes, good luck.
Is there something I can do for you? I am told to make all my goods available.
I never thought I would be so thrilled to see a soldier.
Forgive my previous inaction, but under the Thorian's influence, every thought was examined and filtered.
Of course. Return in the future and I may even have more to see.
I'll show you what I have, but don't expect me to restock. I'm leaving as soon as the next transport comes in.
I may stay, try to recover my losses. I can have new supplies delivered within weeks.
Perhaps the colony will survive after all.
Feros is a lost cause for a common trader like me. There are better markets on any number of worlds.
I wish you well in your future efforts.
Greetings. What can I do for you?
What's a salarian doing on a human colony?
How do you keep things in stock in conditions like this?
Let me see what you have in stock.
What will you do now that the fighting is over?
What do you have for sale?
What are your plans now?
Stock
My full name is Gorot II Heranon Mal Dinest Got Inoste Ledra.
Humans usually employ surname and given name only: Inoste and Ledra in my case.
What's your name, salarian?
My list of consumers has shrunk significantly since the attacks, and few of those have time for "shopping".
We are named for our origins. Gorot II is my homeworld; Heranon, my clan's country. Mal Dinest and Got are the city and district where I live.
Why is your name so long?
Long enough?
I fear the geth will kill us all.
I'm not a fighter. I'm a merchant.
This is not a safe place.
Left unchecked, the geth will soon overwhelm us.
This salarian goes where the credits are. Or I did.
A fascinating place, by all accounts. Though the geth have made it treacherous.
You might like it here too, if you gave it chance, Commander.
I never thought I'd stay in one place for long, but here.... I will stay here.
I can't give you an answer to that, Commander. At least not one that you would comprehend.
Why not try asking Fai Dan? Maybe he can tell you what I can't.
What can you tell me about Zhu's Hope?
This place is barely holding together. Why stay here?
Head to the tunnels. Make sure they're secure.
But... what if I find geth there?
Are you saying you won't go?
No! I'll go. I'll... go.
But... I don't know how to use a gun.
Beat them with the end of it if you have to.
Just don't let those geth get by you.
We've got geth in the tower.
The tower's secure. Thanks to you, Commander.
It's the company most of us worked for before the attacks. They fund this colony.
If you want answers, go ask them yourselves.
Commander? What can I do for you?
The geth fighters are too dangerous. And I won't be driven off this world. It is... our home.
Help me find what the geth are after and you'll all get out of here alive.
Tell me about your colony.
What can you tell me about the defenses the geth have set up?
I'll talk to you when I learn more.
How do I get there?
What's ExoGeni?
Tell me what the geth want. Why are they attacking you?
The Normandy isn't huge, but we could airlift you out.
Life is hard and often brutal, even without our current problems.
But, despite everything, there's something tranquil about this place. Unlike anything I've experienced before.
We were nearly a thousand at the main site. Two hundred more at my outpost.
There is a chance for growth here that is simply not available on other worlds.
I don't have any details, but I'll wager it's a lot more fortified than the command post.
